<cite ref="Berakhot 53a:31">Ber. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>בנות ישראל מקטרות לכ׳</he> daughters of Israel (in large places) are suspected of letting incense rise for sorcerous practices.
<cite ref="Eruvin 64b:19">Erub. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>בדורות אחרונים … פרוצות בכ׳</he> in these latter days when daughters of Israel are unrestrained in practicing sorcery.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 67a:19">Snh. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>מצויות בכ׳</he> habitually inclined to sorcery, v. <cite ref="K01323"><he>כַּשְׁפָּנִית</he></cite>. Y. Kidd. IV, end, 66ᶜ <he>בעלת כ׳</he> sorceress; a. fr.
